title: Месть поваров за Шефа  (The Cooks' Revenge for the Chef)

segments.t: At the restaurant, Kristina confronts the staff over the mess in the kitchen while Valdemar Barani waves a smug goodbye until tomorrow. Sympathizing with their humiliated boss, Senya and Fedya suggest scratching Barani's car in the courtyard, while Barinov vows to settle the score himself.
Или хотя бы машина ему покоца.
Right, let's take their exchange slowly and unpack the Russian.
'I lost track of you.' The meaning hinges on 'I' working together with 'lost' in spoken Russian.
'Forgive me, Kristina.' In Russian, the idea of 'forgive' flows naturally into 'Kristina' without extra filler words.
'Are you aware of this?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'and' before landing on 'course'. Kristina answers right away.
'What your old friend just pulled off?' The '-l' ending on the verb meaning 'caused' places the action in the masculine past tense.
'Just look at that.' Chef Viktor brings out the contrast between 'you' and 'look' in a few short words.
'Gentlemen, it was a pleasure meeting you.' Notice how Russian expresses 'gentlemen' and 'to meet' with crisp inflection rather than helper words. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'See you tomorrow.' The meaning hinges on 'until' working together with 'tomorrow' in spoken Russian.
'Chef, maybe we should kill him, huh?' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'chef' before landing on 'and'.
Или хотя бы машина ему покоца.
'Or at least scratch up his car.' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'or', while 'to scratch' completes the thought. Kristina answers right away.
'You know, that sheep's car.' In Russian, the idea of 'come on' flows naturally into 'of this' without extra filler words.
'Leave Volodka alone.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'leave' before landing on 'peace'.
'It broke the man.' The '-a' ending on the past-tense verb for 'to break' marks a female speaker or subject. Chef Viktor answers right away.
'We will see who beats whom.' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'we' and finishing on 'whom'. Now let's listen to the entire scene again without interruption.
Или хотя бы машина ему покоца.

That wraps up this scene as kristina scolds the staff for the damaged equipment, and after Barani leaves for the night, Senya and Fedya offer to vandalize his luxury car to avenge Chef Barinov. Until next time!
